Give a child a steady tomorrow

Giving to Lighthouse is a simple bank transfer. There are no fees and no accounts to create. Please follow the three steps below.

1

Choose your gift

Monthly gifts help us plan ahead. Set a recurring transfer in your banking app on a date that suits you.

A one-time gift can cover a special need such as medical bills, school fees or a celebration.
